limitations: present+integrated means bytes exist, setup assigns a clip, source selects it; it does not prove the active Editor scene, WebGL build, or visible quality.
Missing clip families refer to the audited 34 original + 2 pilot clips. Procedural alternatives remain possible without paid jobs.
integrated-quality-defect identifies demonstrable generic/partial source substitutions; visual severity is unmeasured.
No new rig/contact-phase measurement, rendered screenshot/video, device performance measurement or licence decision.
Source parser depends on explicit clip names and branch syntax. Unknown/unassigned catalog fields remain unproven; adapt when selector structure changes.
Native tackle result/legality remains authoritative; origin/outcome details are not inferred as new gameplay states.

recommendedFixes.task: Preserve native slide/slideRecovery phase, prioritise foul then slide over ordinary action; add low-body slide and supplied-progress recovery in Unity. Validate gain/deflection/miss/front/side/back/foul without gameplay change.
Reuse existing foul_stumble_meshy for foulOffender, measure appropriate source window and integrate floor/rise continuity; do not buy/generate first.
Reuse keeper_shuffle_meshy from measured lateral displacement and facing; test both sides, readiness, urgent dive and rise.
Fill standing tackle and aerial/throw body pose gaps using isolated procedural/local candidates. Existing generic ground pass/shot do not demonstrate crossing or volley quality.
Demonstrate throw-in preparation/holding/release, distinct catch/parry/rebound and keeper distribution signals before introducing broader fields.
Render reproducible actual Unity sequences in TV and close view, both directions, pause/replay, normal/large pitch, 12/14 players. Source audit alone cannot accept 3D quality.

checks: Actual original GLB hash matches frozen manifest
34 actual original clips, 28 actual rig joints
Binary clip list agrees with existing baseline
Pilot asset hashes and prefab binding root
Clip assignment maps all current original/pilot catalogued fields
Parser separates world actions from demo actions
All requested families represented and exact classifications
Clip presence alone never proves Unity wiring
Picture contract actually projects pass/contact and prioritises foul
tests.method: Node asset decoding, source mapping and actual picture-contract execution; no Unity runtime tests
